Rapiscan, an OSI Systems Company, is seeking a Software Engineer 1 to develop and maintain proprietary desktop and web-based software. The role collaborates with team members and subject matter experts to deliver customer requirements, and supports software for inspection and imaging systems.

Responsibilities
Perform all phases of the software life cycle development, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, documentation, peer reviews, unit testing, and sustainment
Maintain and enhance existing and legacy software using current toolsets and DevOps methods. Support and troubleshoot the CargoInspect software portfolio, improving long-term sustainability and identifying potential improvement opportunities
Apply knowledge of imaging formats and standards, e.g., TIFF, JPEG, PNG, DICOS, or custom domain-specific formats
Debug software issues and optimize performance for high-throughput image processing
Stay current with emerging technologies in imaging software, and visualization techniques
Participate in planning activities with the Product Owner and other stakeholders
Provide technical support for installation, implementation, troubleshooting, and maintenance of software products to field engineering and commissioning teams
Uphold the company’s core values of Integrity, Innovation, Accountability, and Teamwork
Demonstrate behavior consistent with the company’s Code of Ethics and Conduct
It is the responsibility of every employee to report to their manager or a member of senior management any quality problems or defects in order for corrective action to be implemented and to avoid recurrence of the problem
Duties may be modified or assigned at any time to meet the needs of the business
